title: Build catalog entries
responsibility: Turns active units and plans into catalog entries, marks owned file changes, and excludes pages that only load data from the visible list.

inputs.name: catalogUnit.unit
inputs.description: The unit definition, including its identity, kind, active status, title, responsibility, owned files and optional recorded-preview selection. Inactive units and kinds without a catalog category are omitted.

inputs.name: catalogUnit.changed
inputs.description: The changed file paths to compare with this unit. A change counts when it equals an owned path or falls beneath an owned directory; paths are compared as supplied.

inputs.name: catalogListed.units
inputs.description: The unit definitions for the revision being listed. A page is excluded only when it owns at least one file and every owned file is a page loader named +page.js, +page.ts, +page.server.js or +page.server.ts.

inputs.name: catalogListed.items
inputs.description: The existing catalog entries to filter. Entries keep their order; only identities belonging to loader-only pages are removed.

inputs.name: planCatalog.plan
inputs.description: The plan whose goal, lifecycle, threads and design versions should appear. The last version in the supplied array is treated as the latest; its first image supplies the thumbnail.

inputs.name: planCatalog.unit
inputs.description: An existing catalog entry to enrich, or null to create a planned entry from the plan identity, category and title. An existing entry keeps its identity, kind, title and verification status.

inputs.name: planCatalog.changed
inputs.description: Changed file paths used to mark the plan as changed when its stored path, or a path beneath it, appears. An existing changed mark is retained.

outputs.name: catalogUnit
outputs.description: A catalog entry, or null for an inactive or uncategorized unit. New entries start with unknown verification, no plan, no design versions and zero threads. Pages receive a recorded-thumbnail request even without an explicit preview; components receive one only with a preview; other categories have no thumbnail.

outputs.name: catalogListed
outputs.description: A new list with loader-only pages removed by identity. This filters the list without changing or deleting the supplied entries or unit definitions.

outputs.name: planCatalog
outputs.description: A catalog entry with the plan goal, lifecycle, thread count and latest design information. A latest design image takes priority; without one, the existing implemented screenshot selection is retained. Planned-only entries without an image keep an explicit gap. Approval alone does not verify behavior, and only a current approval marks the latest version approved.
